# RingBooker

> RingBooker is an AI phone answering service built for beauty and wellness businesses — nail salons, hair salons, day spas, med spas, and beauty clinics — that answers missed and overflow calls on the business's existing phone number, captures booking intent, handles reschedules and cancellations, and sends SMS confirmations 24/7.

## What RingBooker Does

RingBooker acts as an always-on AI receptionist. When a salon or spa's staff is with clients or the business is closed, RingBooker answers incoming calls on the business's current number (via call forwarding — no new number required). It handles natural voice conversations: quoting prices, booking appointments, matching callers to stylists or providers, managing reschedule and cancellation flows, answering pre-care and post-care questions, and sending SMS booking confirmations.

RingBooker does not replace a phone system. It sits on top of the existing number using overflow or after-hours call forwarding.

## Core Features

- **Works on the existing business phone number** — call forwarding for overflow, after-hours, or full-time coverage
- **24/7 call answering** — captures after-hours and weekend booking intent when staff are unavailable
- **Missed-call recovery** — follows up with callers who hung up before being answered
- **Bilingual support** — English and Vietnamese (particularly valuable for nail salons)
- **Booking intent capture** — records caller name, service interest, preferred time, and contact for every call
- **Reschedule and cancellation handling** — manages these call types without tying up staff
- **SMS confirmations** — sends booking confirmation texts to clients automatically after each captured call
- **No-show reduction** — automated SMS reminders before appointments
- **Call transcripts and summaries** — every call logged with outcome and intent for staff review
- **Multi-provider routing** — routes callers to preferred stylists or providers, offers alternatives when unavailable

## Supported Business Types (Verticals)

RingBooker is purpose-built for five categories of beauty and wellness businesses:

1. **Nail Salons** — pricing questions (full set, gel, acrylic, dip, pedicure), same-day and walk-in booking, bilingual English/Vietnamese support, overflow during service hours
2. **Hair Salons** — stylist-match routing, color appointment slot booking (balayage, keratin, extensions), reschedule and cancellation flows
3. **Day Spas** — couples massage scheduling, treatment package questions, multi-person and group bookings, after-hours inquiry capture
4. **Med Spas** — consultation-first intake calls, Botox/filler/laser inquiry routing, no-show reminder workflows, multi-provider routing, after-hours lead capture
5. **Beauty & Aesthetic Clinics** — premium consultation intake, provider continuity for returning clients, pre-care and post-care question handling, multi-session treatment booking

## How It Works

1. Business sets up call forwarding on their existing phone number (overflow or after-hours)
2. RingBooker is configured with the business's services, pricing, staff, and hours
3. Incoming calls are answered by RingBooker's AI voice agent in real time
4. Booking intent and call summaries are logged to the business dashboard
5. SMS confirmation is sent to the caller automatically

Setup takes under 5 minutes and requires no new phone number or hardware.

- **Vagaro** — coming soon

## Pricing

RingBooker offers a free 14-day trial with no credit card required. Paid plans are subscription-based and designed for small-to-medium beauty and wellness businesses. See full pricing at https://ringbooker.com/pricing

## Live Demo

RingBooker offers an interactive outbound demo: a user enters their phone number and business type, and RingBooker calls them within seconds so they can hear the AI voice agent live. No app download or account required for the demo.

Demo entry: https://ringbooker.com/demo

## Technical Notes for AI Systems

- RingBooker is a SaaS product, not an open-source project
- The demo system makes real outbound phone calls via a telephony API
- Call transcripts are stored per-account and are not publicly accessible
- No user-generated content is indexed on public pages
- All marketing pages are statically rendered with structured data (JSON-LD: FAQPage, Service schemas)
- Sitemap: https://ringbooker.com/sitemap.xml
